<script>
(async()=>{
 const setState=window.__setLoadState||(()=>{});
 async function unpack(id){
   const el=document.getElementById(id), b64=el.textContent.trim();
   const bin=atob(b64), bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
   if(!('DecompressionStream' in window))throw new Error('当前浏览器不支持本地压缩数据解码，请使用新版 Safari / Chrome');
   const ds=new DecompressionStream('gzip');
   const text=await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(ds)).text();
   el.textContent=''; el.remove(); return text;
 }
 function run(code){const s=document.createElement('script');s.textContent=code;document.body.appendChild(s);}
 try{
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40));

   const core=await unpack('dbPayload');
   run(core); run("\nconst $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];\nconst S={step:0,name:'张三',appearance:{height:176,build:'匀称',skin:'#d7a27c',face:'柔和椭圆',hair:'#181510',hairStyle:'短碎发',eye:'#4b382d',vibe:'安静克制'},hub:null,route:null,socialJob:'书记员',powerPath:'NONE',powerJob:'无正式超凡职业'};\n$('#dataCount').textContent=`${DB.meta.hubs} HUB · ${DB.meta.routes} 前传 · ${DB.meta.threads} THREAD`;\n\nfunction escapeHtml(s=''){return String(s).replace(/[&<>\"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;'}[c]))}\nfunction drawAvatar(){\n const a=S.appearance, svg=$('#avatar'); const width={纤细:56,匀称:64,结实:72,修长:58}[a.build]||64;\n let hairPath=a.hairStyle==='齐肩'?`M55 93 Q52 40 100 31 Q148 40 145 93 L151 145 Q132 132 126 84 Q100 62 74 84 Q68 132 49 145Z`:\n a.hairStyle==='束发'?`M57 83 Q58 37 100 30 Q142
